title: Tenshō Iga War
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Tenshō Iga War", at revision 1380172061, opens: "Tenshō Iga War  is the collective name for the conflicts between the Iga ikki and the Oda clan during the Sengoku period. The province was conquered by Oda Nobunaga in 1581 after an unsuccessful attempt in 1579 by his son Oda Nobukatsu. The third insurrection occurred in June 1582, after Oda Nobunaga's deaths during the Honnoji Incident." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q15436846, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "invasions of Iga province by forces under Oda Nobunaga". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
